move: five heavily blurred colour blobs circle slowly under drifting fog and grain
how: Inside a wrapper with filter blur(70px) saturate(1.2), five 760px radial-gradient blobs circle once per loop on ellipses (radii 300 to 380 by 160 to 260), alternating direction, and breathe scale 1 to 1.25 on one sine; the wrapper rocks 4 degrees. An SVG feTurbulence fog rect in soft-light blend drifts on a 60px circle, a fine-noise grain sits over it at 12% overlay, and an italic serif caption sits at the bottom. All values come from t via gsap.set.
adapt: Change the five blob colours, the ground colour and the caption; keep single-cycle sines so the 7s loop closes, and keep blur(70px) for the haze.
port: mount(el, shot) appends .wrap with blobs, the fog and grain SVGs (unique filter ids) and caption; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one {t:0->D, ease:none} tween whose onUpdate runs the seek(t) gsap.set calls. Scope '.blob', '#fogRect', '.wrap' to el.
caveats: filter blur(70px) over a 130% wrapper plus two feTurbulence full-frame filters is very slow to render
SVG filter ids #f and #g are document-level
